# SELFFITS Academy

> Global Online Fitness & Martial Arts Academy providing interactive live coaching via Zoom & Google Meet.

SELFFITS Academy is a live virtual martial arts and fitness institution serving students in over 15 countries across the USA, UK, UAE, Europe, and Asia. Unlike pre-recorded workout platforms, every class is conducted live with real-time posture correction, progressive belt curriculums, and verifiable rank certifications.

## Core Offerings

- **Kids Martial Arts (Ages 8–20)**: Discipline, self-defense basics, kata forms, focus training, and belt rank evaluations.
- **Adults Martial Arts & Karate (Ages 21+)**: Authentic martial technique, striking combinations, physical conditioning, and rank progression.
- **Ladies Only Fitness & Self Defense**: Female-led high-energy workouts, cardiovascular HIIT, and practical self-defense drills in a dedicated environment.
- **Fitness & Weight Management (HIIT)**: High-intensity interval training for stamina, fat loss, core strength, and functional conditioning.

## Live Virtual Class Format

- **Class Delivery**: Real-time virtual classrooms hosted on Zoom and Google Meet.
- **Feedback Mechanism**: Certified coaches observe form and deliver live corrections to ensure safety and precision.
- **Class Schedules**: Flexible weekly attendance options (1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 days per week) across morning and evening GMT batch timings.
- **Evaluations & Certifications**: Structured belt examinations conducted live with master senseis, leading to verifiable graduation certificates.
